name.title: Name
name.description: Optional label for this platform config block. Device names belong inside the typed switch arrays.

scheduledSwitches.title: Scheduled Switches
scheduledSwitches.description: Virtual switches controlled by local weekly schedule ranges.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for this virtual scheduled switch. The accessory ID is generated from this value.

defaultState.title: Default State
defaultState.description: State outside configured ranges. During a configured range, the switch publishes the opposite state.

entries.title: Schedule Entries
entries.description: Schedule ranges for this virtual switch.

days.title: Days
days.description: Days where this entry starts. Leave empty or omit the field to use every day.

start.title: Start Time
start.description: Local 24-hour time where this entry starts, formatted as HH:mm.

end.title: End Time
end.description: Local 24-hour time where this entry ends, formatted as HH:mm. An end time earlier than the start time creates an overnight range.

enableIntervalCheck.title: Enable Periodic Check
enableIntervalCheck.description: When enabled, this device periodically re-applies the schedule between start and end triggers. When disabled, manual changes remain until the next configured schedule trigger.

intervalMinutes.title: Interval Minutes
intervalMinutes.description: Periodic check interval in minutes, aligned from local 00:00. Used only when periodic checks are enabled.

switches.title: Switches
switches.description: Plain virtual switches with no logic behind them.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for this virtual switch. The accessory ID is generated from this value.

state.title: State
state.description: Start state when no persisted runtime state exists. Runtime changes are saved by the plugin.

intervalSwitches.title: Interval Switches
intervalSwitches.description: Virtual switches that flip state on a configured interval.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for this virtual interval switch. The accessory ID is generated from this value.

state.title: State
state.description: Start state when no persisted runtime state exists. Runtime changes are saved by the plugin.

startTime.title: Start Time
startTime.description: Optional local HH:mm anchor used to calculate interval moments. If omitted, the interval starts when the accessory becomes active.

timerSwitches.title: Timer Switches
timerSwitches.description: Virtual switches that return to a default state after a configured duration.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for this virtual timer switch. The accessory ID is generated from this value.

defaultState.title: Default State
defaultState.description: Inactive state. Any different state starts the timer.

durationMinutes.title: Duration Minutes
durationMinutes.description: Minutes before the switch returns to defaultState after being changed to the active state.
